purpose: Canonical second-order Moller-Plesset perturbation theory; the cheapest non-empirical wavefunction correlation method, available for RHF, UHF and high-spin ROHF references.
requires: an SCF reference (RHF/UHF/ROHF); frozen core applies by default
pairs_with: an auxiliary basis (/C or /J) when the RI variants are used
typical_use: single-point energies and gradients for closed-shell and open-shell organic systems; properties via %mp2 density settings

purpose: RI-approximated MP2: the two-electron integrals are fit in an auxiliary basis in the Coulomb metric, which makes the O(N^5) exchange-operator step a well-parallelised matrix multiplication.
requires: an auxiliary basis (e.g. def2/J or cc-pVTZ/C)
pairs_with: the auxiliary basis given in the simple line (e.g. def2-TZVPP/C)
typical_use: the default way to run MP2 in ORCA; faster than canonical MP2 for all but very small molecules

purpose: Grimme's spin-component-scaled MP2: same-spin and opposite-spin contributions get separate empirical scaling factors, improving non-covalent interaction energies over plain MP2.
requires: same as MP2/RI-MP2/DLPNO-MP2 depending on the chosen variant
pairs_with: PS/PT scaling factors can be set in the %mp2 block
defaults: PS = 6/5 for SCS-MP2 (opposite-spin; SOS uses its own factors); settable via PS/PT in %mp2
typical_use: non-covalent interactions, reaction energies where MP2 overestimates dispersion

manual.section: 3.9.3 Calculating MP2 and RI-MP2 Energies (SCS discussion)

purpose: Domain-based local pair-natural-orbital MP2: localises the orbitals and truncates PNO spaces, reproducing RI-MP2 to chemical accuracy at near-linear scaling; beneficial from ~a few hundred atoms on.
requires: an auxiliary basis; localized orbitals (default Localize)
defaults: thresholds reproduce about 99.9% of the RI-MP2 correlation energy; UHF variant uses different PNO spaces than RHF
typical_use: large molecules (several hundred atoms), energies of weakly interacting systems
literature: Pinski, P.; Riplinger, C.; Valeev, E. F.; Neese, F., J. Chem. Phys., 2015, 143, 034108

purpose: Orbital-optimized RI-MP2: the molecular orbitals are re-optimised in the presence of the MP2 correction, which eases systems where the HF reference is poor (e.g. bond stretching, biradicals).
requires: an auxiliary basis; an SCF reference

purpose: Regularized MP2 (%mp2 DoRegMP2): damps the first-order amplitudes with an energy-gap dependent regularizer to fix MP2's overbinding for pi-driven dispersion and transition-metal dative bonds; single-point energies only.
requires: MP2 or RI-MP2 (RIJDX, RIJCOSX, RIJK)
excludes: gradients, densities and Hessians (not yet supported)
defaults: RegMP2Type 0 (kappa), RegMP2Kappa 1.1, RegMP2Sigma 0.5; type 1 = sigma, 2 = sigma^2
typical_use: noncovalent interactions and transition-metal thermochemistry at MP2 cost
literature: Shee, J.; Loipersberger, M.; Rettig, A.; Lee, J.; Head-Gordon, M., J. Phys. Chem. Lett., 2021, 12, 12084-12097

purpose: %mp2 PS/PT: the opposite-spin (PS) and same-spin (PT) scaling factors of spin-component-scaled MP2.
defaults: PS = 6/5 by default for SCS-MP2; PT default for SCS per Grimme's study

purpose: %mp2 NatOrb: generate MP2 natural orbitals; the manual recommends inspecting them to judge the single-reference character or to feed more compact wavefunctions to subsequent methods.

manual.section: 3.9.8 MP2 Properties, Densities and Natural Orbitals

purpose: %mp2 F12: switch on the explicitly-correlated (F12) correction for MP2, accelerating convergence to the basis-set limit.
requires: an auxiliary basis and a CABS basis (F12 modules)
defaults: false (the F12 simple keywords set it)

purpose: %mp2 MP2Solver: chooses the integral-partitioning family for MP2 (e.g. RIJDX conventional RI storage vs RIJCOSX vs RIJK chain-of-spheres).
defaults: appropriate default for the chosen keyword

purpose: %mp2 EWin: orbital energy window deciding which MOs enter the correlation treatment; a tool for excluding close-lying core/valence levels in edge cases.
defaults: respects %method settings; frozen core on by default

purpose: Coupled cluster with singles and doubles; the reference single-reference wavefunction method, size-extensive and usually preferred over QCISD when the HF reference is poor but static correlation is not dominant.
requires: RHF or UHF reference; auxiliary basis for the RI variants
excludes: CASSCF reference (use AUTOCI/MDCI MR methods instead)
typical_use: single-point energies for molecules where DFT fails; S-diagnostic printed to judge reference quality

purpose: CCSD plus the perturbative triples correction; the 'gold standard' for single-reference energetics, achieving high accuracy largely through error cancellation between (T) and missing connected quadruples.
requires: CCSD-capable module; Triples 1 or 2 in %mdci selects the algorithm
defaults: triples off unless the (T) keyword is used; algorithm 1 (memory-hungry, fast) vs 2 (less memory, ~2x slower)
typical_use: high-accuracy single-point energies for closed-shell and single-reference open-shell molecules

purpose: CCSD with the explicitly correlated F12 correction for a much faster approach to the complete-basis-set limit; RI-F12 and the cheaper F12D variants exist for large systems.
requires: auxiliary and CABS auxiliary bases (e.g. cc-pVTZ/C, cc-pVTZ/CABS)
pairs_with: an RI/F12 aux basis set; %mdci DoF12 sub-settings
typical_use: near-CBS-quality CCSD(T) energies at triple-zeta cost

manual.section: 3.10.7 Explicitly Correlated Methods: F12-MP2 and F12-CCSD(T)

purpose: Quadratic configuration interaction with singles and doubles; a QC-variant of CISD that is size-extensive, but its linear T1T2 treatment does not fully relax orbitals, so CCSD is preferred for metals.
requires: RHF or UHF reference
note: QCISD is not an OPI simple-keyword enum; it is set via the MDCI CIType option (block option).

purpose: Coupled-electron pair approximation, variants 1-3; size-selective coupled-pair functionals that add a size-consistency correction to CISD; ORCA also ships modified N-variants.
note: CEPA/n spellings are not OPI simple-keyword enums; they are set via the MDCI CIType option (block option).

purpose: Third-order Moller-Plesset energy via the MDCI module, with Grimme's spin-component-scaled SCS-MP3 refinement.
requires: an SCF reference; MDCI integral handling

purpose: Configuration interaction with singles and doubles (truncated CI, not size-extensive); also the CIType inside %mdci and the only method AUTOCI supports for a ROHF reference.
Approximate coupled-cluster model offered through AUTOCI (and as a %autoci CIType) plus an MDCI/STEOM response route; mainly used for excited states rather than ground-state energetics.
Equation-of-motion CCSD for excited, ionized (IP-EOM) and electron-attached (EA-EOM) states on top of a CCSD ground state.
requires: a preceding CCSD treatment of the reference state

purpose: Similarity-transformed EOM-CCSD: an efficient second-order simplification of EOM-CCSD for many excited states, also available with DLPNO localisation (DLPNO-STEOM-CCSD) for large molecules.
%mdci CIType: selects the correlation treatment of the MDCI module (CISD, QCISD, CCSD, the CEPA/CPF/ACPF/AQCC coupled-pair variants and SEOI), so one block serves many related methods.
defaults: set by the simple-input method keyword

purpose: %mdci TCutPNO: cutoff on PNO occupation numbers, the main DLPNO truncation parameter; do not change it directly, use the PNO presets.
%mdci TCutPairs: cutoff for estimated pair correlation energies, exploiting locality in the internal space of DLPNO methods.
%mdci TCutMKN: cutoff for Mulliken populations controlling the domain size of the local fit (and domain construction for DLPNO2013).
%mdci TCutDO: cutoff for the DLPNO domain construction (differential overlap of pairs).
%mdci Triples: selects the perturbative-triples algorithm for CCSD(T)-type runs: 0 off, 1 (fast, memory-hungry), 2 (less memory, about twice as slow, UHF unavailable).
defaults: 0 (no triples) unless a (T) keyword is used

purpose: %mdci EWin: orbital energy window choosing the MOs included in the MDCI correlation treatment (respects %method settings).
%mdci MaxIter: maximum number of coupled-cluster amplitude iterations.
%mdci STol: convergence threshold (max residual-vector element) for the coupled-cluster iterations.
%mdci Denmat: requests the one-particle density of the CI/CC wavefunction (none, linearized, unrelaxed or relaxed), needed for properties.
%mdci Brueckner: optimise Brueckner orbitals, i.e. orbitals for which the T1 amplitudes vanish; diagnostic for a poor HF reference.
%mdci MaxCore: memory (MB) for integral transformations, batching and storage; the manual warns not to be too generous with it.
%mdci InCore: how much of the intermediates/integrals is held in central memory (0..5); AUTO decides based on MaxCore.
%mdci LocMet: the orbital-localisation method used by local correlation (PM, FB, IAOIBO, IAOBOYS, NEWBOYS, AHFB).
%mdci Localize: flag to use localized orbitals in the local-correlation (DLPNO) treatment.
Simple keyword selecting loose DLPNO truncation thresholds: quick estimates where a few tenths of a kcal/mol do not matter.
Simple keyword selecting the default DLPNO truncation thresholds; sensible for general thermochemistry and the recommended baseline.
Simple keyword selecting tight DLPNO thresholds; use when investigating weak interactions or conformational equilibria.
Domain-based local pair natural orbital CCSD: near-linear-scaling CCSD recovering typically 99.8-99.9% of the canonical correlation energy; advantages show beyond ~60 atoms.
requires: an auxiliary basis; localized orbitals
defaults: Linear-scaling DLPNO (since ORCA 4.0) is the default algorithm
typical_use: CCSD-level energies for large molecules (100-1000+ atoms)
literature: Riplinger, C.; Neese, F., J. Chem. Phys., 2013, 138, 034106

purpose: DLPNO-CCSD with perturbative triples, fully linear scaling since 2016; made CCSD(T)-level calculations on entire proteins feasible.
defaults: (T) adds about 10-20% runtime over DLPNO-CCSD for large systems; (T1) is the iterative triples variant

purpose: Special DLPNO truncation settings for hyperfine coupling constants: HFC1 tightened, HFC2 tighter than HFC1, because property calculations are more sensitive to PNO truncation than energies.
note: DLPNO-HFC1/2 are not OPI enum members; they select PNO threshold presets like the LoosePNO/NormalPNO/TightPNO family.

purpose: Local Energy Decomposition: decomposes a DLPNO-CCSD(T) energy into physical contributions (e.g. intra- and interfragment and orbital-pair terms) to interpret coupled-cluster results.
requires: a DLPNO-CCSD(T) calculation
literature: Altun, A.; Neese, F.; Bistoni, G., J. Chem. Theory Comput., 2018 et seq. (LED papers, manual refs 775-777)

purpose: HFLD: Hartree-Fock plus a non-empirical London-dispersion correction; quantifies and analyses noncovalent interactions between two user-defined fragments at very low cost.
literature: Altun, A.; Neese, F.; Bistoni, G., J. Chem. Theory Comput., 2019, 15, 5894-5907 (HFLD)

manual.section: 5.37 The Hartree-Fock plus London Dispersion (HFLD) Method

purpose: PNOExtrapolation (OPI catalog): automatic extrapolation of the PNO space; the manual documents the related iterative-triples (T1) improvement that reproduces canonical (T) energies more accurately.
requires: a DLPNO method

purpose: Complete active space self-consistent field: optimises both orbitals and a full-CI expansion within a chosen active space; the standard treatment for static (strong) correlation.
requires: an active space definition (NEl, NOrb, Mult, NRoots) in %casscf and a suitable starting guess (e.g. AVAS, natural orbitals)
pairs_with: AVAS guess keywords; NEVPT2/CASPT2/DCD-CAS(2) for dynamic correlation; TrafoStep RI with a /C basis
typical_use: bond breaking, transition-metal and actinide complexes, excited states via state averaging

purpose: %casscf NEl: number of active electrons, half of the mandatory active space definition together with NOrb.
%casscf NOrb: number of active orbitals; NEl+NOrb define the CAS.
%casscf Mult: requested spin multiplicity; comma-separated list for several multiplicity blocks, each with its own NRoots.
%casscf Irrep: irreducible representation requested for each multiplicity block (mandatory when symmetry is used).
%casscf NRoots: number of roots (states) computed per multiplicity block; larger values give state-averaged orbitals.
%casscf CIStep: the CI solver inside CASSCF - CSFCI (default), ACCCI (faster multi-root), ICE (approximate CI for large active spaces) or DMRGCI (density-matrix renormalisation group).
pairs_with: ICE: TGen/TVar via the CI sub-block; DMRGCI: %dmrg settings

purpose: %casscf OrbStep: the orbital-optimisation algorithm - SuperCI_PT (default two-step), TRAH (one-step augmented Hessian), SuperCI, DIIS, KDIIS, SOSCF, NR.
%casscf SwitchConv: gradient norm at which OrbStep switches to the final (switchstep) optimiser.
%casscf MaxIter: maximum number of CASSCF macro-iterations.
%casscf ETol/GTol: energy and gradient-norm convergence criteria of the CASSCF orbital optimisation.
defaults: ETol 1e-8, GTol 1e-3 (as shown in the block example)

purpose: %casscf IRoot/IMult: selects root and multiplicity block (counting from zero) for state-specific follow-up steps such as numerical gradients.
%casscf PTMethod: selects the perturbation treatment on the CASSCF reference - SC_NEVPT2, FIC_NEVPT2, DLPNO_NEVPT2 (underscore spelling; simple input uses hyphens).
requires: a converged CASSCF calculation with the NEVPT2-compatible CIStep

purpose: %casscf TrafoStep: enables the RI approximation for the CASSCF gradient/Hessian integral transformation, paired with a /C auxiliary basis.
defaults: exact transformation; RI enabled by DLPNO-NEVPT2

purpose: %casscf BWeight: block weights between multiplicity blocks in a state-averaged calculation (e.g. singlets:triplets = 2:1).
%casscf ActOrbs: the orbital type used for the active space at the end of the calculation (NatOrbs default, CanonOrbs, LocOrbs, dOrbs/fOrbs purification for AILFT, SDO).
N-electron valence state second-order perturbation theory on a CASSCF reference; adds dynamic correlation while staying (quasi-)size-consistent and intruder-free.
requires: a CASSCF calculation; higher-order reduced density matrices (CIStep CSFCI, ACCCI, ICE or DMRGCI)
typical_use: static+dynamic correlation for transition-metal complexes, bond breaking, excited states

purpose: Strongly contracted NEVPT2, the default contraction of the manual's NEVPT2 keyword; block input spells it SC_NEVPT2.
FIC-NEVPT2 in the DLPNO framework for large molecules; automatically switches TrafoStep to RI.
requires: a CASSCF reference; auxiliary basis

purpose: Fully internally contracted CASPT2, the FIC variant, as alternative second-order perturbation theory on a CASSCF reference; RI-CASPT2 adds the RI approximation.
requires: a CASSCF reference

purpose: CASSCF initial-guess keyword: builds an active space from the valence d orbitals of all transition-metal atoms via singular-value decomposition against MINAO target AOs; overwrites NEl/NOrb in %casscf.
requires: TM atoms in the molecule; overwrites the %casscf active space
typical_use: automatic CAS(n,5) d-spaces for TM complexes before CASSCF/NEVPT2
literature: Sayfutyarova, E. R.; Sun, Q.; Chan, G. K.-L.; Knizia, G., J. Chem. Theory Comput., 2017, 13, 4063-4078

purpose: AVAS variant with double-shell d targets: both 3d and 4d (or 4d+5d) functions per TM centre, for double-shell active spaces.
AVAS variant targeting seven f functions per lanthanide or actinide atom; Double-F is the double-shell analogue.
AVAS valence-d variant with s functions added for sigma bonding participation, per the OPI catalog; the manual documents the Valence-D/Double-D/Valence-F/Double-F family.
Activates the AUTOCI correlation module (e.g. AUTOCI-CCSD, AUTOCI-CCSD(T), AUTOCI-MP4): automatically code-generated canonical CI/CC/MPn methods with analytic gradients; disables MDCI.
requires: RHF (or ROHF with RunROHFasUHF) reference; all integrals on disk
typical_use: methods not implemented in the hand-written modules (e.g. MP4, CCSDT variants) and their gradients
literature: Krupicka, M.; Sivalingam, K.; Huntington, L.; Auer, A. A.; Neese, F., J. Comput. Chem., 2017, 38, 1853-1868; Lechner, M. H. et al., Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys., 2024, 26, 15205-15220

purpose: %autoci CIType: the correlation method of the AUTOCI module - CID, CISD, CISDT, CCD, CCSD, CCSDT, CEPA(0), QCISD, CC2, CC3, CCSD[T], CCSD(T), the CCSDT-1..4 series, FIC-MRCI family, and MP2-MP5.
defaults: set by the AUTOCI-<method> simple keyword

purpose: %autoci STol: residue convergence tolerance of the CI/CC iterations.
%autoci MaxIter: maximum number of correlation iterations.
%autoci MaxDiis: depth of the DIIS memory in the correlation iterations.
%autoci LevelShift: level shift in the DIIS update / denominators.
%autoci NEl: number of active electrons for the CAS (multireference) AUTOCI methods; taken from the preceding CASSCF run by default.
%autoci NOrb: number of active orbitals for CAS-based AUTOCI methods.
%autoci Mult: requested multiplicity block for CAS-based AUTOCI methods.
%autoci NRoots: number of roots for the multiplicity block (CAS only).
%autoci Irrep: requested irreducible representation for the multiplicity block (CAS only).
%autoci Density: the one-body density requested (linearized, unrelaxed or relaxed); gradients compute both unrelaxed and relaxed automatically.
%autoci RunROHFasUHF: feed ROHF orbitals into the AUTOCI UHF modules, because only CISD is available for a genuine ROHF reference.
%autoci KeepInts: keep the transformed MO integrals on disk for reuse; UseOldInts then reuses them (user is responsible for their validity).
%autoci UseOldInts: reuse transformed integrals previously stored with KeepInts; only the dimension is checked.

Iterative Configuration Expansion CI: selected-CI approximation to full CI controlled by two thresholds; used for near-FCI small-molecule energies, low-lying state searches, or as CI solver for large active-space CASSCF (ICE-SCF).
requires: a %ice (or %casscf CIStep ICE) block with NEl/NOrb or the auto-ICE occupation-window selection; MP2 natural orbitals recommended
defaults: TGen = 1e-4, TVar = 1e-7*TGen (negative TVar means the ratio); error about 1 mEh vs full CI
typical_use: approximate full CI; large CASSCF active spaces beyond the ~14-orbital limit
literature: Chilkuri, V. G.; Neese, F., J. Comput. Chem., 2021, 42, 982-1005; Chilkuri, V. G.; Neese, F., J. Chem. Theory Comput., 2021, 17, 2868-2885

purpose: %ice TGen: generator threshold, the parameter that controls ICE-CI accuracy; convergence is limited much more by TGen than by TVar.
%ice TVar: variational selection threshold of ICE-CI; a negative value means 1e-7 * TGen, which is the recommended default.
%ice ICEType: the many-particle representation of the ICE expansion - CFGs (default), CSFs or determinants (DETs).
%ice Integrals: integral transformation for the ICE-CI Hamiltonian - exact or RI; the CSF route can run without RI when NOrb >> NEl.
%ice NEl: number of active electrons of the ICE-CI space.
%ice NOrb: number of active orbitals of the ICE-CI space.
%ice NRoots: number of roots requested from the ICE-CI solver.
%ice Mult: requested spin multiplicity of the ICE-CI calculation.
%ice Irrep: requested irreducible representation; only supported for ICEType=CFGs.
%ice ETol: energy convergence tolerance of the ICE-CI iterations.
Not a %casscf option: ORCA's parser rejects this spelling; convergence of the CI step belongs in the CI sub-block (ETol/RTol).
Not an %mp2 option under this spelling (ORCA rejects it); the PNO iteration limit is MaxPNOIter.
Not an %mp2 option (ORCA rejects this spelling); orbital-convergence tolerances belong to the SCF/method blocks.
Not an %mdci option under this spelling (ORCA rejects it); response DLPNO settings use the documented TCut keywords.
